summary: Discussion-sourced fast screening: vendor agent incidents, major vendor product deltas (Anthropic, OpenAI), operator workflows for credential handling and MCP hygiene, and emergent infra/security risks (PyPI compromise, MCP repo secrets, agent leaks). | Vendor-only screening: prioritize OpenAI model/product launches, AWS Bedrock AgentCore fleet updates, infra security advisories (GHSA), and vendor operator guidance (JetBrains, AWS). | GitHub-OSS screening: official releases from GitHub/OpenAI/Anthropic plus many OSS agent frameworks and infra primitives; most project signals are repo-only and need social/third-party corroboration. | Packages-only shard: many new agent-focused packages (VS Code agent extensions, eval tooling, sandboxing, detection, memory). No social/operator reports in this snapshot; several single-source PyPI/npm/crates entries need corroboration.
